summary: A constant named MAX_DOCS = 8 capped NOTHING — it only ordered a list. Believing the name re-rolled a settled $11,701 income to $3,129 on the Wilson file.
detail: Renamed to STUB_PRIORITY_WINDOW. Before reasoning from any constant, open its call sites.

summary: EXTRACT_SYSTEM in docFacts.ts had ZERO importers. A YTD fix was written there, shipped, and changed nothing.
detail: READ_ONE_SYSTEM in this file is the only prompt that runs. grep the importers before editing a prompt.

summary: Borrower-specific figures (37,689 / 40,818) were used as an EXAMPLE inside this SHARED prompt. The reader anchored on them and returned the same YTD for two different stubs.
detail: State rules generically. Never put one borrower's numbers in a prompt every borrower is read with.

summary: One employer printed two ways split into two jobs: 'SANTA MONICA COM COLLEGE' vs the same name with its parent district double-counted a salary at $9,932/mo; an IRS transcript's 'EXTR REAC TALE INC' never merged with 'EXTREME REACH TALENT, INC.'
detail: sameEmployerStem (containment) + isAbbrevOf (token truncation). A WRONG merge deletes a real second income — test both directions.

summary: LOGIC_VERSION is GLOBAL. Bumping it invalidated every file's stability cache at once, and the AI read is non-deterministic, so every borrower's settled number could move.
detail: Bump only when the MATH changed. That cache exists because of 'income I verified last week is different this week on the same file'.

summary: $4,898.05/mo of VA compensation sat in a bank statement (VACP TREAS 310) while the file qualified that borrower at $750. Bank statements were only mined for the deposit-AVERAGE method.
detail: A status doc (DD-214/COE) proves income EXISTS. Ask where the money LANDS — Treasury ACH codes name the program.

summary: /api/competitors was in apiProtected but MISSING from config.matcher — fully public until an adversarial review caught it.
detail: Both lists, always. npm run verify:auth proves it in milliseconds.
